statement_map.email_excerpt: You came with a list covering your thank-you page, mobile landing page, email domain, invoices and course.
Your thank-you page redirect is set up, and your test order now goes to your page.
The overlapping mobile buttons are fixed, and you confirmed they look fine.
Email domain: add your domain in Email settings, add the three DNS records at your registrar, then click Verify.
EARLYBIRD coupon: if you extend it, change the expiry date in the coupon settings.
Lesson drip: a drip schedule setting exists for lessons.
AI quiz generator: we are not aware of one being available right now and have no date for one, so please do not plan around it.
Have your developer add the three DNS records by Friday.
Once they are added, click Verify in your email settings.
Export your student list: Students, Export, then CSV (you said you would try this later).
We will check with our billing team about changing the name on your invoices and get back to you within 2 working days.
We will check with our product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle and get back to you.
